original_question: Mark leere nwale nke nwere ajụjụ iri asaa na ise ụnyaahụ. O lechara nwale ahụ n'ọnụ nha ajụjụ ise kwa awa. Taata, o leere nwale ọzọ nwere ajụjụ otu narị n'ọnụ nha ajụjụ ise kwa awa.
